title: ICS 232 Resources at Risk Summary
description: Environmental Unit summary of the sites at risk from a release, laid out like the Coast Guard ICS 232-CG: environmentally sensitive areas and wildlife concerns in one table, archeo-cultural and socio-economic sites (water intakes, marinas, fisheries, cultural sites) in another, each with an incident priority and its site issues. Built from the Area Contingency Plan sites, the ESI map and the trajectory forecast. About 10 rows fit on the page across the two tables.

marking.description: Exercise marking line shown above and below the form (defaults to EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE)

forecastBasis.description: Which trajectory forecast the priorities follow (an incident note, not a numbered block)
examples: Trajectory run 04 Nov 0600, 48 h, best estimate

landfall.description: Earliest predicted contact with a listed site (an incident note)
examples: 1420 on 04 Nov, Heron Bay marsh mouth

resources.description: Block 4. Environmentally sensitive areas and wildlife concerns, in priority order

site.description: Site # (from the Area Contingency Plan or Geographic Response Plan, or assigned in the incident)

priority.description: Priority for this incident (1 is first)

location.description: Physical location (landmark or latitude and longitude)

arrival.description: Predicted contact time, shown in the narrative

examples: Nesting colony; April to August closed to boats

strategy.description: Narrative: protection strategy and other details
examples: Deflection boom, 600 ft, anchor at mouth
